text.p: Inter-Regional Financial Group Inc said Tuesday its board of directors approved a change of the company's name to Interra Financial.

Interra's brokerage and investment banking subsidiaries, Dain Bosworth and Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, will remain unchanged, but IFG Asset Management Services has changed to Interra Advisory Services and clearing unit Regional Operations Group became Interra Clearing Services, the company said.
Among reasons for the name change was that another financial firm has a trademark on the acronym IFG, the company said.
Effective Monday the company's new ticker symbol on the New York Stock Exchange will be IFI, the company said.
